sets.example_zh: 这张卡能让你借阅图书馆的书。

sets.example_en: Please enclose a photo when you send the application form.
sets.example_zh: 寄申请表时请附上一张照片。

sets.example_en: I looked up volcanoes in an old encyclopaedia at the library.
sets.example_zh: 我在图书馆一本旧百科全书里查阅了火山。

sets.example_en: Smoke from the engine forced the driver to pull off the road.
sets.example_zh: 发动机冒烟，司机只好把车停到路边。

sets.example_en: I felt a little envy when I saw her prize.
sets.example_zh: 看到她的奖品时我有点羡慕。

sets.example_en: Water is essential for life.
sets.example_zh: 水对生命至关重要。

sets.example_en: The ticket costs twelve euro if you buy it online today.
sets.example_zh: 如果今天在网上购买，这张票要十二欧元。

sets.example_en: We met on the eve of the exam.
sets.example_zh: 我们在考试前夕见了面。

sets.example_en: The doctor will examine your sore throat today.
sets.example_zh: 医生今天会检查你疼痛的喉咙。

sets.example_en: The magazine printed an excerpt from her travel diary.
sets.example_zh: 杂志刊登了她旅行日记中的一段摘录。

sets.example_en: Football finals excite the whole neighbourhood every spring.
sets.example_zh: 每年春天，足球决赛都让整个社区兴奋起来。

sets.example_en: Our experiment showed that plants grow faster beside a sunny window.
sets.example_zh: 我们的实验表明，植物在向阳的窗边长得更快。

sets.example_en: The puzzled expression on his face showed he had missed the joke.
sets.example_zh: 他脸上困惑的表情说明他没听懂那个笑话。

sets.example_en: I need extra time.
sets.example_zh: 我需要额外的时间。

sets.example_en: The dentist had to extract a tooth that had been hurting.
sets.example_zh: 牙医不得不拔掉那颗一直作痛的牙。

sets.example_en: The soup is extremely hot.
sets.example_zh: 这汤非常烫。

sets.example_en: She raised one eyebrow when I told her the strange story.
sets.example_zh: 我讲起那个奇怪的故事时，她扬起了一边眉毛。

sets.example_en: The failure of the first rocket taught the club to check the fuel.
sets.example_zh: 第一枚火箭失败之后，社团学会了先检查燃料。

sets.example_en: A faint smell of bread came from the bakery down the street.
sets.example_zh: 街那头的面包店飘来一股淡淡的面包味。

sets.example_en: That watch looks expensive, but the logo is fake.
sets.example_zh: 那块表看起来很贵，但上面的标志是假的。

sets.example_en: The film is a fantasy about dragons.
sets.example_zh: 这部电影是关于龙的奇幻故事。

sets.example_en: Dinosaurs fascinate my little brother more than any cartoon.
sets.example_zh: 恐龙比任何动画片都更让我弟弟着迷。

sets.example_en: The family prepared a feast for Grandpa's seventieth birthday.
sets.example_zh: 家人为爷爷的七十岁生日准备了一桌盛宴。

sets.example_en: A white feather drifted down from the bird above the roof.
sets.example_zh: 一根白羽毛从屋顶上方的鸟儿身上飘了下来。

sets.example_en: A stone bridge is the main feature of our town.
sets.example_zh: 一座石桥是我们小镇的主要特征。

sets.example_en: She lent a tissue to her fellow passenger on the crowded train.
sets.example_zh: 她在拥挤的火车上把纸巾借给了同行的乘客。

sets.example_en: A female referee controlled the final with a firm whistle.
sets.example_zh: 一位女裁判用有力的哨声掌控了决赛。

sets.example_en: The dog squeezed through a gap in the garden fence.
sets.example_zh: 狗从花园篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

sets.example_en: We took the ferry across the river to reach the old town.
sets.example_zh: 我们乘渡船过河，去到那座古城。

sets.example_en: Could you fetch a clean towel from the bathroom?
sets.example_zh: 你能去浴室拿一条干净毛巾吗？

sets.example_en: I prefer fiction to news.
sets.example_zh: 比起新闻我更喜欢小说。

sets.example_en: Sherlock Holmes is a fictional detective in those London stories.
sets.example_zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯是那些伦敦故事里的虚构侦探。

sets.example_en: Nobody dared to pass the fierce dog outside the warehouse.
sets.example_zh: 没有人敢从仓库外面那条凶猛的狗身边经过。

sets.example_en: Daily swimming slowly changed his figure over the summer.
sets.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的身形在那个夏天慢慢变了。

sets.example_en: Dad copied the file onto a memory stick at home.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸在家把文件复制到了存储盘上。

sets.example_en: The shark's fin cut through the water near the boat.
sets.example_zh: 鲨鱼的鳍在船附近划开了水面。

sets.example_en: The fisherman returned at dawn.
sets.example_zh: 渔民黎明时回来了。

sets.example_en: The eagle's flight over the valley looked calm and strong.
sets.example_zh: 鹰飞越山谷的飞行看起来平稳而有力。

sets.example_en: Paper boats float down the stream after the summer rain.
sets.example_zh: 夏雨过后，纸船顺着小溪漂下去。

sets.example_en: Mix the flour with water.
sets.example_zh: 把面粉和水混合。

sets.example_en: After the storm, the river's flow became fast and muddy.
sets.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，河水流动得又急又浑。

sets.example_en: Fold the paper in half.
sets.example_zh: 把纸对折。

sets.example_en: It was foolish to leave my phone on the bus seat.
sets.example_zh: 把手机落在公交车座位上太愚蠢了。

sets.example_en: A muddy footprint marked the clean floor near the door.
sets.example_zh: 门边干净的地板上留着一个泥脚印。

sets.example_en: Phones are forbidden in the exam room from start to finish.
sets.example_zh: 从开始到结束，考场里都禁止使用手机。

sets.example_en: The weather forecast says it will rain.
sets.example_zh: 天气预报说会下雨。

sets.example_en: The parade moved forth down the main street after the drums started.
sets.example_zh: 鼓声响起后，游行队伍沿着大街向前走。

sets.example_en: We were fortunate to find seats on the crowded holiday train.
sets.example_zh: 我们很幸运，在拥挤的假日火车上找到了座位。

sets.example_en: Children played near the fountain.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们在喷泉附近玩。

sets.example_en: One half is a fraction, and we use it to share a pizza.
sets.example_zh: 二分之一是一个分数，我们用它来分食一块披萨。

sets.example_en: The wooden frame around the class photo came loose.
sets.example_zh: 班级合影周围的木框松了。

sets.example_en: Fry the eggs in a little oil.
sets.example_zh: 用少许油煎鸡蛋。

sets.example_en: Loud thunder can frighten our dog at night.
sets.example_zh: 夜里的响雷会把我们的狗吓到。

sets.example_en: The empty alley looked frightening after the street lights went out.
sets.example_zh: 路灯熄灭后，空荡荡的小巷看起来令人害怕。

sets.example_en: A frog jumped into the pond.
sets.example_zh: 一只青蛙跳进池塘。

sets.example_en: Dad will frown if you leave dirty plates in the sink.
sets.example_zh: 如果你把脏盘子留在水槽里，爸爸会皱眉。

sets.example_en: The school raised a fund for books.
sets.example_zh: 学校筹集了一笔购书资金。

sets.example_en: After running through the rain, the cat's fur was soaked.
sets.example_zh: 在雨里跑过之后，猫身上的软毛湿透了。

sets.example_en: We bought some new furniture for the bedroom.
sets.example_zh: 我们为卧室买了一些新家具。

sets.example_en: The hotel is cheap; furthermore, it is close to the station.
sets.example_zh: 这家旅馆便宜；此外，它离车站很近。

sets.example_en: He shouted in fury when someone broke his new skateboard.
sets.example_zh: 有人弄坏他的新滑板时，他暴怒地大喊起来。

sets.example_en: Mum was furious because I came home two hours late.
sets.example_zh: 我晚了两个小时才回家，妈妈气坏了。

sets.example_en: Please do not make a fuss about a small stain on your shirt.
sets.example_zh: 衬衫上只有一小块污渍，请别大惊小怪。

sets.example_en: You gain confidence when you speak in front of the class.
sets.example_zh: 当你在全班面前发言时，你会获得自信。

sets.example_en: Bikes and a spare tyre fill the garage behind the house.
sets.example_zh: 自行车和一只备用轮胎塞满了屋后的车库。

sets.example_en: Runners gasp for air after the long race around the track.
sets.example_zh: 绕着跑道长跑结束后，选手们大口喘气。

sets.example_en: We gather fallen leaves in the school garden.
sets.example_zh: 我们在学校花园里把落叶收集起来。

sets.example_en: Stories pass from one generation to the next.
sets.example_zh: 故事一代代传下去。

sets.example_en: It was generous of you to pay for dinner.
sets.example_zh: 你请客真慷慨。

sets.example_en: The young genius solved the puzzle quickly.
sets.example_zh: 那位年轻的天才很快解开了谜题。

sets.example_en: She spoke in a gentle voice.
sets.example_zh: 她说话声音很温柔。

sets.example_en: She gently placed the goldfish back into the bowl.
sets.example_zh: 她轻轻地把金鱼放回了鱼缸。

sets.example_en: With one gesture, the coach sent the substitute onto the field.
sets.example_zh: 教练做了一个手势，让替补队员上了场。

sets.example_en: Some children say a ghost lives in the old school building.
sets.example_zh: 有些孩子说老教学楼里住着一个鬼。

sets.example_en: The giant statue in the square is taller than our school building.
sets.example_zh: 广场上那座巨大的雕像比我们的教学楼还高。

sets.example_en: Yellow ginkgo leaves cover the pavement outside our school in autumn.
sets.example_zh: 秋天，学校外面的人行道铺满了黄色的银杏叶。

sets.example_en: She took a quick glance at the clock and ran for the bus.
sets.example_zh: 她迅速瞥了一眼时钟，然后跑去赶公交。

sets.example_en: Glutinous rice dumplings are a traditional food at the Dragon Boat Festival.
sets.example_zh: 糯米粽是端午节的传统食物。

sets.example_en: A goat stood on the rocky hill.
sets.example_zh: 一只山羊站在石山上。

sets.example_en: Golden sunlight filled the playground just before the bell rang.
sets.example_zh: 铃声响起前，金色的阳光洒满了操场。

sets.example_en: My goldfish swims in circles whenever I tap the glass.
sets.example_zh: 我一敲玻璃，金鱼就转着圈游。

sets.example_en: A goose chased us away from the pond in the park.
sets.example_zh: 公园池塘边，一只鹅把我们赶走了。

sets.example_en: The gorilla sat quietly and watched the children outside the glass.
sets.example_zh: 大猩猩安静地坐着，看着玻璃外面的孩子。

sets.example_en: The dancer looked graceful as she moved across the stage.
sets.example_zh: 舞者穿过舞台时，姿态看起来很优美。

sets.example_en: Rice is an important grain.
sets.example_zh: 水稻是一种重要的谷物。

sets.example_en: A grand parade filled the main street on National Day.
sets.example_zh: 国庆节那天，隆重的游行挤满了主街。

sets.example_en: Every grandchild received a red envelope during the family dinner.
sets.example_zh: 家庭晚宴上，每个孙辈都收到了一个红包。

sets.example_en: Her granddaughter visits every week.
sets.example_zh: 她的孙女每周来看她。

sets.example_en: Grandma packed dumplings for our early train this morning.
sets.example_zh: 奶奶今天早上为我们的早班火车包了饺子。

sets.example_en: Grandpa walks in the park every morning before breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 爷爷每天早饭前都在公园里散步。

sets.example_en: I wrote a letter to my grandparent.
sets.example_zh: 我给祖父母写了一封信。

sets.example_en: Their grandson is in junior high.
sets.example_zh: 他们的孙子在上初中。

sets.example_en: My granny taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
sets.example_zh: 外婆教我怎样把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

sets.example_en: Draw a graph to show how the temperature changed this week.
sets.example_zh: 画一张图表，显示这周气温是怎样变化的。

sets.example_en: Grate some cheese over the pasta before you serve it.
sets.example_zh: 上桌之前，在意大利面上磨一些奶酪。

sets.example_en: We were grateful when a stranger returned my brother's phone.
sets.example_zh: 一位陌生人送回了我弟弟的手机，我们非常感激。

sets.example_en: She expressed her gratitude by writing a card to the coach.
sets.example_zh: 她给教练写了一张卡片，以此来表达感激。

sets.example_en: Copy the numbers into the grid before you start the puzzle.
sets.example_zh: 开始做谜题之前，先把数字抄进网格里。

sets.example_en: He could not hide a grin when his team scored the winner.
sets.example_zh: 球队打进制胜球时，他忍不住咧嘴一笑。

sets.example_en: He felt guilty about the broken window.
sets.example_zh: 打碎窗户后他感到内疚。

sets.example_en: The wetland is a habitat for birds.
sets.example_zh: 湿地是鸟类的栖息地。

sets.example_en: I cannot find my hairbrush, so my hair is a mess today.
sets.example_zh: 我找不到发刷，所以今天头发乱糟糟的。

sets.example_en: She changed her hairstyle before the school photo last week.
sets.example_zh: 上周学校拍照之前，她换了发型。

sets.example_en: She wrapped cheese in ham for the party snacks.
sets.example_zh: 她用火腿裹上奶酪，当作聚会的小吃。

sets.example_en: She left her handbag on the chair.
sets.example_zh: 她把手提包落在椅子上了。

sets.example_en: During the drill, the officer locked one handcuff around the chair leg.
sets.example_zh: 演练时，警官把一只手铐锁在了椅腿上。

sets.example_en: He carried a cotton handkerchief.
sets.example_zh: 他带了一块棉手帕。

sets.example_en: Her handwriting is clear and neat.
sets.example_zh: 她的字迹清楚工整。

sets.example_en: I prefer a handwritten card to a message sent on the phone.
sets.example_zh: 比起手机上发来的消息，我更喜欢手写的卡片。

sets.example_en: Fishing boats returned to the harbour before the storm arrived.
sets.example_zh: 暴风雨到来之前，渔船返回了港口。

sets.example_en: Harry forgot his sports shoes and had to borrow a pair.
sets.example_zh: 哈里忘了带运动鞋，只好借了一双。

sets.example_en: A hawker sold grilled corn outside the stadium after the match.
sets.example_zh: 比赛结束后，一名小贩在体育场外卖烤玉米。

sets.example_en: I have a headache and need to rest.
sets.example_zh: 我头痛，需要休息。

sets.example_en: Grandma told us kind people go to heaven after they die.
sets.example_zh: 奶奶告诉我们，善良的人死后会上天堂。

sets.example_en: A helicopter flew low over the beach during the rescue drill.
sets.example_zh: 救援演练时，一架直升机低低地飞过海滩。

sets.example_en: Without hesitation, she jumped into the pool to help her friend.
sets.example_zh: 她毫不犹豫地跳进泳池去帮朋友。

sets.example_en: Highlight the key dates on your revision sheet.
sets.example_zh: 在复习提纲上把重要的日期标出来。

sets.example_en: A new high-rise beside the station has shops on the ground floor.
sets.example_zh: 车站旁的一座新高层建筑，底层有商店。

sets.example_en: Falling off his bicycle, my brother hurt his left hip badly.
sets.example_zh: 弟弟从自行车上摔下来，把左边的臀部摔伤了。

sets.example_en: Near the river, a huge hippo stood still and opened its wide mouth.
sets.example_zh: 在河边，一头巨大的河马静静站着，张开了大嘴。

sets.example_en: We visited a historic castle during the weekend trip.
sets.example_zh: 周末出游时，我们参观了一座有历史意义的城堡。

sets.example_en: After school we play hockey on the field behind the gym.
sets.example_zh: 放学后，我们在体育馆后面的场地上打曲棍球。

sets.example_en: With a short speech, the students paid homage to the old scientist.
sets.example_zh: 学生们发表简短讲话，向那位老科学家致敬。

sets.example_en: Hooray, our class won the city basketball match this afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 好哇，我们班今天下午赢了全市篮球赛。

sets.example_en: When the bell rings, the children hop across the playground together.
sets.example_zh: 铃一响，孩子们就一起单脚跳着穿过操场。

sets.example_en: There was a horrible noise outside.
sets.example_zh: 外面有可怕的响声。

sets.example_en: Dad bought me a hotdog and a cold drink at the stadium.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸在体育场给我买了一个热狗和一杯冷饮。

sets.example_en: After heavy rain, the air felt humid all over the city.
sets.example_zh: 大雨过后，全城的空气都感觉很潮湿。

sets.example_en: He told a humorous story.
sets.example_zh: 他讲了一个幽默的故事。

sets.example_en: In the story, a family builds an igloo from blocks of snow.
sets.example_zh: 故事里，一家人用雪块搭了一座冰屋。

sets.example_en: Don't ignore the warning signs.
sets.example_zh: 不要忽视雾警标志。

sets.example_en: Parking on the pavement is illegal in our city.
sets.example_zh: 在我们这座城市，把车停在人行道上是非法的。

sets.example_en: Please come immediately.
sets.example_zh: 请立刻过来。

sets.example_en: The museum left a deep impression on my little sister.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆给我妹妹留下了深刻的印象。

sets.example_en: Her painting of the lake was impressive at the show.
sets.example_zh: 她画的那幅湖景在展览上令人印象深刻。

sets.example_en: The hero is an incarnation of courage in that old adventure film.
sets.example_zh: 在那部老冒险片里，主人公是勇气的化身。

sets.example_en: The puddle grew an inch deeper after the noon storm.
sets.example_zh: 中午的暴风雨过后，水坑又深了一英寸。

sets.example_en: Menus improve with the inclusion of fresh fruit at lunch.
sets.example_zh: 午餐菜单因为纳入新鲜水果而变得更好。

sets.example_en: Sorry for the inconvenience, but the lift is closed for repair.
sets.example_zh: 电梯正在维修，给您带来不便，非常抱歉。

sets.example_en: She became more independent at university.
sets.example_zh: 她在大学里变得更加独立。

sets.example_en: Sugar is the main ingredient in this homemade strawberry cake.
sets.example_zh: 糖是这块自制草莓蛋糕的主要原料。

sets.example_en: My initial reaction was surprise.
sets.example_zh: 我最初的反应是惊讶。

sets.example_en: She took the initiative and booked the room for our meeting.
sets.example_zh: 她采取主动行动，为我们的会议订好了房间。

sets.example_en: Be careful, or you may injure your knee on the icy road.
sets.example_zh: 小心，不然你可能会在结冰的路上伤到膝盖。

sets.example_en: Blue ink spilled across my notebook during the art lesson.
sets.example_zh: 美术课上，蓝墨水洒在了我的笔记本上。

sets.example_en: We stayed at a quiet inn beside the lake last weekend.
sets.example_zh: 上周末，我们住在湖边一家安静的小旅馆里。

sets.example_en: Before the school trip, an inspector checked every bus carefully.
sets.example_zh: 学校旅行开始前，一位检查员仔细检查了每一辆公共汽车。

sets.example_en: Please instruct the new players before the football match starts.
sets.example_zh: 足球比赛开始前，请指导一下新队员。

sets.example_en: Please don't interrupt the speaker.
sets.example_zh: 请不要打断发言的人。

sets.example_en: The telephone was a great invention.
sets.example_zh: 电话是一项伟大的发明。

sets.example_en: In daylight, the tiny crack in the glass was almost invisible.
sets.example_zh: 在日光下，玻璃上的那道细裂纹几乎看不见。

sets.example_en: I received an invitation to my cousin's birthday party on Sunday.
sets.example_zh: 我收到了星期天参加表哥生日聚会的请柬。

sets.example_en: Please italicize the book title when you type the reading list.
sets.example_zh: 录入阅读书单时，请把书名排成斜体。

sets.example_en: One item on the list was sold out by noon.
sets.example_zh: 清单上有一项到中午就卖光了。

sets.example_en: She spread jam on the toast.
sets.example_zh: 她在吐司上抹了果酱。

sets.example_en: Jam filled the jar that Grandma sealed last summer.
sets.example_zh: 果酱装满了奶奶去年夏天封好的广口瓶。

sets.example_en: He rubbed his sore jaw.
sets.example_zh: 他揉了揉酸痛的下巴。

sets.example_en: Tom felt jealous when his brother got a new bicycle.
sets.example_zh: 弟弟得到一辆新自行车时，汤姆感到很嫉妒。

sets.example_en: Can you juggle three apples without dropping them on the floor?
sets.example_zh: 你能抛接三个苹果，还不让它们掉到地上吗？

sets.example_en: Rare birds live in the jungle.
sets.example_zh: 珍稀鸟类生活在丛林里。

sets.example_en: A kangaroo jumped across the road.
sets.example_zh: 一只袋鼠跳过了马路。

sets.example_en: Lucy is keen on swimming and goes to the pool every morning.
sets.example_zh: 露西热衷于游泳，每天早上去游泳池。

sets.example_en: Near the park, police stopped a man who tried to kidnap the child.
sets.example_zh: 在公园附近，警察拦住了一个企图绑架那个孩子的男子。

sets.example_en: Last night police caught the kidnapper near the railway station.
sets.example_zh: 昨晚警察在火车站附近抓住了绑架者。

sets.example_en: Dad used a repair kit from the boot to fix the flat tyre.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸用后备箱里的成套工具修好了瘪胎。

sets.example_en: Players kneel on the grass when they tie their football boots.
sets.example_zh: 球员系足球鞋带时跪在草地上。

sets.example_en: Check the label on the bottle before you take any medicine.
sets.example_zh: 吃药之前，先看一看瓶子上的标签。

sets.example_en: We heated the liquid in the laboratory during chemistry class.
sets.example_zh: 化学课上，我们在实验室里加热了那种液体。

sets.example_en: Farm labour starts early when the rice is ready to cut.
sets.example_zh: 稻子可以收割时，田间劳动一大早就开始了。

sets.example_en: The lamb stayed close to its mother.
sets.example_zh: 羊羔紧紧跟着母亲。

sets.example_en: Visitors photograph the old clock tower, a famous landmark in our city.
sets.example_zh: 游客拍摄那座老钟楼，它是我们城市的著名地标。

sets.example_en: Doctors used a laser to treat the player's injured eye.
sets.example_zh: 医生用激光治疗了那位球员受伤的眼睛。

sets.example_en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet at the weekend book sale.
sets.example_zh: 周末售书时，一位志愿者递给我一张宣传单。

sets.example_en: Our school joined a football league with four nearby towns.
sets.example_zh: 我们学校和附近四个城镇一起参加了足球联盟。

sets.example_en: Before moving in, the family signed a lease for a flat near school.
sets.example_zh: 入住前，这家人签了学校附近一套公寓的租约。

sets.example_en: I went to a lecture on space travel.
sets.example_zh: 我参加了一个关于太空旅行的讲座。

sets.example_en: On hot days I drink lemonade under the tree in our garden.
sets.example_zh: 天热的日子里，我在花园的树下喝柠檬水。

sets.example_en: The length of the pool is marked on the wall tiles.
sets.example_zh: 泳池的长度标在墙面的瓷砖上。

sets.example_en: They fought for liberty.
sets.example_zh: 他们为自由而奋斗。

sets.example_en: The librarian helped me find the book.
sets.example_zh: 图书管理员帮我找到了那本书。

sets.example_en: You need a driving licence to rent a car here.
sets.example_zh: 在这里租车需要驾驶执照。

sets.example_en: Along the mountain path, grey lichen grows on the wet rocks.
sets.example_zh: 沿着山路，灰色的地衣长在潮湿的岩石上。

sets.example_en: A healthy diet can help increase a person's lifespan.
sets.example_zh: 健康的饮食有助于延长人的寿命。

sets.example_en: His lifestyle changed when he started cycling to work.
sets.example_zh: 他开始骑自行车上班以后，生活方式变了。

sets.example_en: Grandpa says this trip is the best holiday of his lifetime.
sets.example_zh: 爷爷说，这次旅行是他一生中最好的假期。

sets.example_en: Click the link on the school site to see the bus times.
sets.example_zh: 点击学校网站上的链接，就能看到校车时间。

sets.example_en: Water is a liquid.
sets.example_zh: 水是液体。

sets.example_en: The recipe needs a litre of milk and two eggs.
sets.example_zh: 这个食谱需要一升牛奶和两个鸡蛋。

sets.example_en: Share your location with Dad when you change buses downtown.
sets.example_zh: 在市区换乘公交时，把你的位置发给爸爸。

sets.example_en: Students log their running times in a sports notebook.
sets.example_zh: 学生们把每次跑步的时间记在运动笔记本上。

sets.example_en: A lone bird sat on the roof before the storm arrived.
sets.example_zh: 暴风雨来临前，有一只鸟独自停在屋顶上。

sets.example_en: The button is loose.
sets.example_zh: 这颗扣子松了。

sets.example_en: Loosen your tie if you feel too hot during the match.
sets.example_zh: 如果比赛时觉得太热，就把领带松开。

sets.example_en: At dawn a big lorry carried fresh vegetables into the market.
sets.example_zh: 黎明时分，一辆大卡车把新鲜蔬菜运进了市场。

sets.example_en: I forgot my lunchbox on the kitchen table this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上，我把午餐盒忘在厨房的桌子上了。

sets.example_en: This lychee is sweet, so I bought a bag at the fruit stall.
sets.example_zh: 这荔枝很甜，所以我在水果摊买了一袋。

sets.example_en: Madame Chen welcomed the guests at the door of the hotel.
sets.example_zh: 陈夫人在旅馆门口迎接客人。

sets.example_en: The afternoon mail included a birthday card from my aunt.
sets.example_zh: 下午的邮件里有姑姑寄来的生日贺卡。

sets.example_en: She put on light make-up before the school concert began.
sets.example_zh: 学校音乐会开始前，她化了淡妆。

sets.example_en: During summer, families row on the man-made lake in the park.
sets.example_zh: 夏天，家家户户在公园的人工湖上划船。

sets.example_en: This old camera is manual and has no screen.
sets.example_zh: 这台旧相机是手动的，没有屏幕。

sets.example_en: Local workers manufacture bicycles for schools across the city.
sets.example_zh: 本地工人为全市的学校制造自行车。

sets.example_en: Their long marriage began when they were university classmates.
sets.example_zh: 他们长久的婚姻从大学同学时期就开始了。

sets.example_en: During the play, the actor wore a mask and played a brave hero.
sets.example_zh: 演出时，这位演员戴着面具，扮演一位勇敢的英雄。

sets.example_en: He is not materialistic and prefers books to expensive gifts.
sets.example_zh: 他并不贪图物质，比起昂贵的礼物更喜欢书。

sets.example_en: The maximum speed on this road is thirty kilometres an hour.
sets.example_zh: 这条路的最高时速是三十公里。

sets.example_en: One safety measure is keeping bags out of the aisle.
sets.example_zh: 一项安全措施是不把书包放在过道里。

sets.example_en: We shared a cold melon after playing basketball in the sun.
sets.example_zh: 在太阳下打完篮球后，我们分吃了一个冰镇甜瓜。

sets.example_en: The smell of rain brings back a memory of my first camp.
sets.example_zh: 雨的气味让我想起第一次露营的记忆。

sets.example_en: Can you mend the hole in my school bag before Monday?
sets.example_zh: 你能在星期一之前补好我书包上的破洞吗？

sets.example_en: Yesterday the messenger brought our team a letter from the coach.
sets.example_zh: 昨天，信使给我们队带来了教练的一封信。

sets.example_en: The gate is made of metal and rattles in strong wind.
sets.example_zh: 大门是金属做的，大风时会哗啦作响。

sets.example_en: The singer held the mike and sang for the whole school.
sets.example_zh: 歌手握着麦克风，为全校演唱。

sets.example_en: To build a sports centre, the millionaire gave a large sum of money.
sets.example_zh: 为了建造体育中心，那位百万富翁捐了一大笔钱。

sets.example_en: She collects miniature houses and keeps them on her desk.
sets.example_zh: 她收集微型房屋，并把它们摆在书桌上。

sets.example_en: At seven our minibus left the school gate for the museum.
sets.example_zh: 七点，我们的小型公共汽车从校门口出发去博物馆。

sets.example_en: The minimum age for this ride is twelve years.
sets.example_zh: 玩这个游乐项目的最低年龄是十二岁。

sets.example_en: Pour the mixture into the tin and bake it for twenty minutes.
sets.example_zh: 把混合物倒进烤盘，烤二十分钟。

sets.example_en: Keep a moderate speed when you ride your bike downtown.
sets.example_zh: 在市中心骑自行车时，请保持适中的速度。

sets.example_en: The walk was moderately long, so the children did not feel tired.
sets.example_zh: 这段路长度适中，所以孩子们并不觉得累。

sets.example_en: Teachers monitor the hallway during the lunch break.
sets.example_zh: 老师们在午休时间监视走廊。

sets.example_en: Inside the cartoon, a friendly monster helps children find their home.
sets.example_zh: 动画片里，一只友善的怪物帮助孩子们找到家。

sets.example_en: Salt water damaged the motor of our small fishing boat.
sets.example_zh: 咸水损坏了我们那艘小渔船的发动机。

sets.example_en: Every Saturday my uncle rides a motorcycle to the market.
sets.example_zh: 每个星期六，我叔叔都骑摩托车去市场。

sets.example_en: Travel through this mountainous area is slow but the views are beautiful.
sets.example_zh: 穿越这一多山地区虽然慢，但景色非常美。

sets.example_en: At noon the cook with a thick moustache served us hot noodles.
sets.example_zh: 中午，那位留着浓密小胡子的厨师给我们端上了热面条。

sets.example_en: If you multiply six by four, the answer is twenty-four.
sets.example_zh: 如果你把六乘以四，答案就是二十四。

sets.example_en: Mum packed fruit and bread for our picnic by the river.
sets.example_zh: 妈妈为我们的河边野餐装好了水果和面包。

sets.example_en: The play ends with a murder, so younger pupils should not watch.
sets.example_zh: 这出戏以一场谋杀结束，低年级学生不适合看。

sets.example_en: Daily swimming built muscle in his arms and back.
sets.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的手臂和背部长出了肌肉。

sets.example_en: A wild mushroom grew beside the path after three rainy days.
sets.example_zh: 连着下了三天雨以后，小路边长出了一朵野蘑菇。

sets.example_en: After lunch Grandpa takes a short nap in his armchair.
sets.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅里小睡一会儿。

sets.example_en: The nasty weather cancelled our outdoor PE lesson.
sets.example_zh: 恶劣的天气让我们的室外体育课取消了。

sets.example_en: This young runner is nationally known for winning three races.
sets.example_zh: 这位年轻的赛跑选手因赢得三场比赛而全国闻名。

sets.example_en: The naughty puppy pulled the washing off the line.
sets.example_zh: 那只调皮的小狗把晾着的衣服扯了下来。

sets.example_en: There is a nearby shop.
sets.example_zh: 附近有一家商店。

sets.example_en: Keep your desk neat.
sets.example_zh: 保持桌面整洁。

sets.example_en: She threaded the needle.
sets.example_zh: 她把线穿过了针。

sets.example_en: Birds built a nest in the tree.
sets.example_zh: 鸟在树上筑了巢。

sets.example_en: Our best shot hit the net and never reached the goal.
sets.example_zh: 我们最好的一脚打在网上，球没有进。

sets.example_en: When my pen broke, the nib snapped and I borrowed Amy's pen.
sets.example_zh: 我的钢笔坏了，笔尖断了，于是我借了埃米的笔。

sets.example_en: My niece loves drawing.
sets.example_zh: 我侄女喜欢画画。

sets.example_en: I prefer non-fiction about animals to long adventure stories.
sets.example_zh: 比起长篇冒险故事，我更喜欢关于动物的非小说类作品。

sets.example_en: Birds fly to northern lakes when spring arrives.
sets.example_zh: 春天来临时，鸟儿会飞向北方的湖泊。

sets.example_en: Please notify the office if you cannot join the school trip.
sets.example_zh: 如果你不能参加学校旅行，请通知办公室。

sets.example_en: They visited a nuclear museum.
sets.example_zh: 他们参观了一座核博物馆。

sets.example_en: Squirrels hid every nut they found under the oak tree.
sets.example_zh: 松鼠把找到的每一颗坚果都藏到了橡树下面。

sets.example_en: All players must obey the rules during the basketball game.
sets.example_zh: 所有球员在篮球比赛中都必须遵守规则。

sets.example_en: Through a telescope at the observatory, we looked at bright stars.
sets.example_zh: 我们在天文台用望远镜观看明亮的星星。

sets.example_en: For dinner the cook fried an octopus and served it with rice.
sets.example_zh: 晚餐时，厨师炸了一只章鱼，配米饭端上来。

sets.example_en: An odd noise came from the fridge at midnight.
sets.example_zh: 半夜冰箱里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

sets.example_en: An official explained the new rule.
sets.example_zh: 一位官员解释了新规定。

sets.example_en: It is important to believe in oneself when learning a new sport.
sets.example_zh: 学习一项新运动时，相信自己很重要。

sets.example_en: Oops, I dropped the plate of noodles on the kitchen floor.
sets.example_zh: 哎呀，我把一盘面条掉在了厨房的地板上。

sets.example_en: The contest is a good opportunity to show your speaking skills.
sets.example_zh: 这次比赛是展示你口语能力的好机会。

sets.example_en: At the concert our school orchestra played a cheerful piece.
sets.example_zh: 音乐会上，我们学校的管弦乐队演奏了一首轻快的曲子。

sets.example_en: We ate ordinary bread and soup for dinner at home.
sets.example_zh: 我们在家晚饭吃了普通的面包和汤。

sets.example_en: The heart is a vital organ.
sets.example_zh: 心脏是重要器官。

sets.example_en: The aid organisation brought clean water to the flooded streets.
sets.example_zh: 援助组织给被淹的街道送来了干净的水。

sets.example_en: You ought to bring your book tomorrow.
sets.example_zh: 你明天应该把书带来。

sets.example_en: The captain will outline the match plan before kickoff.
sets.example_zh: 队长会在开球前概述比赛计划。

sets.example_en: Eight people can sit around the oval table in the dining room.
sets.example_zh: 八个人可以围坐在餐厅里的椭圆形桌子旁。

sets.example_en: Before dinner he hung his overcoat on a hook by the door.
sets.example_zh: 晚饭前，他把大衣挂在门边的钩子上。

sets.example_en: Bright music from the overture filled the hall before the opera.
sets.example_zh: 歌剧开始前，序曲明快的音乐充满了大厅。

sets.example_en: People need oxygen to live.
sets.example_zh: 人需要氧气才能生存。

sets.example_en: A package arrived this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上到了一个包裹。

sets.example_en: Inside this pamphlet you can find the city museum's opening hours.
sets.example_zh: 这本小册子里可以找到市博物馆的开放时间。

sets.example_en: Heat the pan before you add oil.
sets.example_zh: 加油前先把锅烧热。

sets.example_en: Along the main street, a colourful parade moved slowly past us.
sets.example_zh: 一支色彩缤纷的游行队伍沿着大街从我们身边缓缓走过。

sets.example_en: She found a part-time job at the bookshop after school.
sets.example_zh: 她放学后在书店找到了一份兼职工作。

sets.example_en: Please paste the photo onto the card for your friend.
sets.example_zh: 请把这张照片粘到送给朋友的卡片上。

sets.example_en: Mum will pat the baby softly when he starts to cry.
sets.example_zh: 宝宝一开始哭，妈妈就会轻轻地拍他。

sets.example_en: A muddy path leads from the back gate to the field.
sets.example_zh: 一条泥泞的小路从后门通向操场。

sets.example_en: Please pause the film so we can fetch some snacks.
sets.example_zh: 请把电影暂停一下，我们去拿些零食。

sets.example_en: After dark, please keep to the pavement on your walk home.
sets.example_zh: 天黑以后走路回家，请走人行道。

sets.example_en: Back at the harbour, a pelican swallowed the fish it had caught.
sets.example_zh: 回到港口后，一只鹈鹕吞下了它抓住的鱼。

sets.example_en: This pencil costs fifty pence at the shop near school.
sets.example_zh: 这支铅笔在学校附近的商店卖五十便士。

sets.example_en: What percentage of the class passed?
sets.example_zh: 班上及格的百分比是多少？

sets.example_en: You need permission from your parents before the camping trip.
sets.example_zh: 野营旅行之前，你需要得到父母的许可。

sets.example_en: Farmers use less pesticide so the vegetables stay safer to eat.
sets.example_zh: 农民少用杀虫剂，这样蔬菜吃起来更安全。

sets.example_en: In the story a phantom appears in the old castle at night.
sets.example_zh: 故事里，一个幽灵在夜里出现在古堡中。

sets.example_en: In front of the palace, this photograph shows our whole family.
sets.example_zh: 这张照片是我们全家人在宫殿前拍的。

sets.example_en: Regular physical exercise helps students stay strong and healthy.
sets.example_zh: 经常进行身体锻炼有助于学生保持强壮和健康。

sets.example_en: A tall pine stands beside the path up the hill.
sets.example_zh: 一棵高大的松树立在上山的小路旁。

sets.example_en: Fresh pineapple tastes wonderful with cold yoghurt after sport.
sets.example_zh: 运动之后，新鲜菠萝配上冰酸奶，味道好极了。

sets.example_en: Water leaked from the pipe.
sets.example_zh: 管子漏水了。

sets.example_en: She wore a plain dress to the family dinner.
sets.example_zh: 她穿了一条朴素的裙子去参加家庭晚餐。

sets.example_en: The train leaves from platform 4.
sets.example_zh: 火车从4号站台出发。

sets.example_en: My little sister goes to playschool every weekday morning.
sets.example_zh: 我妹妹每个工作日早上都去幼儿园。

sets.example_en: A pleasant breeze cooled us during the picnic.
sets.example_zh: 野餐时，一阵令人愉快的微风让我们凉快下来。

sets.example_en: The plot twisted when the detective guessed wrong.
sets.example_zh: 侦探猜错的时候，剧情发生了转折。

sets.example_en: The plump baker smiled and handed us warm bread.
sets.example_zh: 那位丰满的面包师微笑着递给了我们热面包。

sets.example_en: The flag hangs from a tall pole.
sets.example_zh: 旗子挂在一根高杆上。

sets.example_en: Ducks swam on the pond.
sets.example_zh: 鸭子在池塘里游。

sets.example_en: Speakers at the fair played pop all afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 集市的喇叭放了一下午流行音乐。

sets.example_en: During the funny film, we shared a large box of popcorn.
sets.example_zh: 看那部有趣的电影时，我们分吃了一大盒爆米花。

sets.example_en: Pack your possessions carefully before you leave the hotel room.
sets.example_zh: 离开旅馆房间之前，请小心收拾你的财物。

sets.example_en: Mum mixed milk powder with warm water for the baby.
sets.example_zh: 妈妈用温水给宝宝冲了奶粉。

sets.example_en: At the seaside restaurant, the prawn soup tasted fresh and hot.
sets.example_zh: 海滨餐馆的对虾汤尝起来又鲜又热。

sets.example_en: Time is precious before an exam.
sets.example_zh: 考试前时间很珍贵。

sets.example_en: Seat belts prevent serious injury on the school bus.
sets.example_zh: 安全带可以防止校车上发生严重伤害。

sets.example_en: Above the open grassland, the eagle searched for prey.
sets.example_zh: 在开阔的草原上空，鹰在搜寻猎物。

sets.example_en: This morning the principal spoke to parents at the school gate.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上，校长在校门口对家长讲话。

sets.example_en: The old prison is now a museum beside the river.
sets.example_zh: 那座旧监狱现在成了河边的博物馆。

sets.example_en: Every month the prisoner wrote a long letter to his family.
sets.example_zh: 那名囚犯每个月都给家人写一封长信。

sets.example_en: Making paper turned out to be a slow process in art club.
sets.example_zh: 在美术社团里，造纸成了一个缓慢的过程。

sets.example_en: At the city concert hall, the young prodigy played the piano.
sets.example_zh: 在市音乐厅，那位年少的神童弹奏了钢琴。

sets.example_en: The professor explained the theory clearly.
sets.example_zh: 教授把理论讲得很清楚。

sets.example_en: In a sentence, a pronoun can take the place of a name.
sets.example_zh: 在句子里，代词可以用来代替名字。

sets.example_en: Check the pronunciation in a dictionary.
sets.example_zh: 在词典里查发音。

sets.example_en: Starting a chess club was her proposal to the teacher.
sets.example_zh: 成立国际象棋社团，是她向老师提出的倡议。

sets.example_en: This job offers a good career prospect.
sets.example_zh: 这份工作有很好的职业前景。

sets.example_en: Eggs are a good source of protein.
sets.example_zh: 鸡蛋是很好的蛋白质来源。

sets.example_en: Use a protractor to measure the angle in your maths book.
sets.example_zh: 用量角器量一量你数学书里的角。

sets.example_en: On the way to school, the child jumped over a deep puddle.
sets.example_zh: 在上学的路上，那个孩子跳过了一个深水坑。

sets.example_en: Suddenly a puff of wind blew the paper off the picnic table.
sets.example_zh: 突然一阵风把纸从野餐桌上吹走了。

sets.example_en: Farmers use a pump to draw water from the deep well.
sets.example_zh: 农民用泵从深井里抽水。

sets.example_en: On a cold autumn evening, we made pumpkin soup for dinner.
sets.example_zh: 在一个寒冷的秋夜，我们做了南瓜汤当晚餐。

sets.example_en: Every pupil has a workbook.
sets.example_zh: 每个学生都有一本练习册。

sets.example_en: Whenever someone comes home, our puppy runs to the door.
sets.example_zh: 每当有人回家，我们的小狗就跑向门口。

sets.example_en: The mountain stream looks pure enough to drink.
sets.example_zh: 山里的溪水看起来纯净得可以直接喝。

sets.example_en: Her purse was in the desk drawer.
sets.example_zh: 她的钱包在书桌抽屉里。

sets.example_en: This city map puzzle has more than one hundred pieces.
sets.example_zh: 这幅城市地图拼图有一百多块。

sets.example_en: For many travellers, the pyramid in the desert is a famous sight.
sets.example_zh: 对许多旅行者来说，沙漠里的金字塔是一处著名景观。

sets.example_en: Ducks quack loudly when children throw bread into the pond.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们把面包扔进池塘时，鸭子会大声嘎嘎叫。

sets.example_en: You need a teaching qualification for this job.
sets.example_zh: 您需要获得此工作的教学资格。

sets.example_en: We bought a large quantity of rice before the camp.
sets.example_zh: 野营前，我们买了数量很多的大米。

sets.example_en: Do not quarrel with your brother over such a small toy.
sets.example_zh: 不要为了这么一个小玩具和弟弟争吵。

sets.example_en: Students returned the health questionnaire before lunch today.
sets.example_zh: 学生们今天午饭前交回了健康问卷。

sets.example_en: Outside the stadium, a long queue formed before the big match.
sets.example_zh: 大赛开始前，体育场外排起了长队。

sets.example_en: Don't quit when the work gets hard.
sets.example_zh: 工作变难时不要放弃。

sets.example_en: Our history quiz is on Friday, so I am reviewing tonight.
sets.example_zh: 我们的历史小测验在星期五，所以我今晚在复习。

sets.example_en: I left my tennis racket in the club after practice yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天训练后，我把网球拍落在俱乐部了。

sets.example_en: We crossed the calm river on a wooden raft last summer.
sets.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘木筏渡过了平静的河。

sets.example_en: Bring a raincoat because the sky looks dark this afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 今天下午天色阴沉，带上一件雨衣吧。

sets.example_en: As we left the park, a single raindrop fell on my hand.
sets.example_zh: 我们离开公园时，一滴雨落在了我的手上。

sets.example_en: She rarely eats sweets because she wants to stay healthy.
sets.example_zh: 她很少吃甜食，因为她想保持健康。

sets.example_en: Behind a bin, a rat hid after running across the street.
sets.example_zh: 一只老鼠跑过马路后，躲到了垃圾箱后面。

sets.example_en: Don't eat the fish raw.
sets.example_zh: 鱼不要生吃。

sets.example_en: If the front is full, please sit in the rear of the bus.
sets.example_zh: 如果前面坐满了，请坐到公共汽车的后部。

sets.example_en: Can I have a receipt, please?
sets.example_zh: 请给我开个收据，好吗？

sets.example_en: The receptionist gave us a map.
sets.example_zh: 接待员给了我们一张地图。

sets.example_en: This recipe needs two eggs.
sets.example_zh: 这个食谱需要两个鸡蛋。

sets.example_en: Please recite the poem from memory.
sets.example_zh: 请把这首诗背出来。

sets.example_en: I keep this atlas as a reference for geography homework.
sets.example_zh: 我留着这本地图册，当作地理作业的参考。

sets.example_en: His diary may reflect how he felt during exams.
sets.example_zh: 他的日记也许反映了他考试期间的心情。

sets.example_en: The mirror showed a clear reflection of the desk lamp.
sets.example_zh: 镜子里清楚地映出了台灯的反射。

sets.example_en: I regard my coach as a patient and honest person.
sets.example_zh: 我把教练看作一个耐心又诚实的人。

sets.example_en: Visitors come to this region for sweet apples and clean rivers.
sets.example_zh: 游客为了甜苹果和清澈的河流来到这个地方。

sets.example_en: She visits her grandparents regularly.
sets.example_zh: 她经常去看望祖父母。

sets.example_en: They did not reject his idea.
sets.example_zh: 他们没有拒绝他的想法。

sets.example_en: Sleep and test marks show a clear relation in our class.
sets.example_zh: 在我们班，睡眠和考试成绩呈现出明显的关系。

sets.example_en: The zoo will release the healed bird next Saturday.
sets.example_zh: 动物园将在下星期六释放那只痊愈的鸟。

sets.example_en: Hikers rely on a paper map when phones lose signal.
sets.example_zh: 手机没有信号时，徒步的人依靠纸质地图。

sets.example_en: We moved to a smaller flat when the rent increased.
sets.example_zh: 租金上涨以后，我们搬进了更小的公寓。

sets.example_en: Inside the museum hangs a reproduction of an ancient painting.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆里挂着一幅古画的复制品。

sets.example_en: She made a request for more time.
sets.example_zh: 她请求再给一些时间。

sets.example_en: The fishermen were rescued by helicopter.
sets.example_zh: 渔民被直升机救起。

sets.example_en: Clean drinking water for the city comes from this reservoir.
sets.example_zh: 这座水库为城市提供洁净的饮用水。

sets.example_en: Every resident on our street recycled glass last month.
sets.example_zh: 上个月，我们这条街上的每位居民都回收了玻璃。

sets.example_en: Please respond to the email today.
sets.example_zh: 请今天回复这封邮件。

sets.example_en: I revise my history notes on the bus home.
sets.example_zh: 我在回家的公交车上复习历史笔记。

sets.example_en: Evening revision helps me remember the words for Friday's test.
sets.example_zh: 晚上复习能帮我记住星期五测验要考的单词。

sets.example_en: Rex waits by the door until we come home from school.
sets.example_zh: 雷克斯在门口等着，直到我们放学回家。

sets.example_en: These two lines rhyme.
sets.example_zh: 这两行押韵。

sets.example_en: Around her mother's gift, she tied a bright red ribbon.
sets.example_zh: 她在给妈妈的礼物上系了一条鲜红的丝带。

sets.example_en: Can you solve this riddle?
sets.example_zh: 你能解开这个谜语吗？

sets.example_en: Outside the museum, the guard carried a rifle all evening.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆外面，卫兵整晚都持着步枪。

sets.example_en: Near our city, lions roar at night in the wildlife park.
sets.example_zh: 在我们城市附近的野生动物园里，狮子夜里会吼叫。

sets.example_en: Into the crowd the robber ran and dropped the stolen bag.
sets.example_zh: 强盗跑进人群，扔下了偷来的包。

sets.example_en: Within two days the police solved the robbery at the bank.
sets.example_zh: 警察在两天内破获了那起银行抢劫案。

sets.example_en: We did a role-play in which I acted as a shopkeeper.
sets.example_zh: 我们做了角色扮演，我扮演店主。

sets.example_en: A thick root has cracked the path beside the old tree.
sets.example_zh: 一条粗根把老树旁边的小路撑裂了。

sets.example_en: The rough towel felt uncomfortable against my sunburn.
sets.example_zh: 粗糙的毛巾蹭在晒伤处，感觉很不舒服。

sets.example_en: This route avoids the busy junction near the market.
sets.example_zh: 这条路线避开了市场附近拥挤的路口。

sets.example_en: I used a rubber to erase the wrong maths sum.
sets.example_zh: 我用橡皮把算错的那道数学题擦掉了。

sets.example_en: Read the rubric carefully before you start the writing test.
sets.example_zh: 开始写作测验前，请仔细阅读题目说明。

sets.example_en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full of food.
sets.example_zh: 嘴里塞满食物时说话是无礼的。

sets.example_en: They practise rugby on the muddy field behind school.
sets.example_zh: 他们在学校后面泥泞的场地上练习橄榄球。

sets.example_en: They sail across the bay in summer.
sets.example_zh: 夏天他们乘船穿过海湾。

sets.example_en: Her monthly salary covers the rent and the groceries.
sets.example_zh: 她每月的薪水够付租金和买菜的钱。

sets.example_en: Before lunch the children built a sandcastle on the beach.
sets.example_zh: 午饭前，孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

sets.example_en: Heat the milk in a saucepan and then add the sugar.
sets.example_zh: 把牛奶放在煮锅里加热，然后再加糖。

sets.example_en: Dad fried a sausage with eggs before leaving for work.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸上班前用鸡蛋配着煎了一根香肠。

sets.example_en: The opening scene shows a rainy street at night.
sets.example_zh: 开场的场景是夜晚一条下雨的街道。

sets.example_en: From the train window, the scenery looked green and peaceful.
sets.example_zh: 从火车窗口望去，风景翠绿而宁静。

sets.example_en: For our drive, we chose a scenic road through the hills.
sets.example_zh: 驾车出行时，我们选了一条穿过山丘的风景优美的路。

sets.example_en: The exam schedule is pinned beside the classroom door.
sets.example_zh: 考试日程钉在教室门旁边。

sets.example_en: She won a scholarship to university.
sets.example_zh: 她获得了大学奖学金。

sets.example_en: The scientific method starts with a clear question.
sets.example_zh: 科学方法从提出一个清楚的问题开始。

sets.example_en: Do not scratch the paint on the new desk in your room.
sets.example_zh: 不要刮花你房间里新书桌上的漆。

sets.example_en: The injured player began to scream on the football pitch.
sets.example_zh: 那名受伤的球员在足球场上开始惨叫。

sets.example_en: When the thunder started, the little screamer ran to his mum.
sets.example_zh: 开始打雷时，那个尖叫的小孩跑向了妈妈。

sets.example_en: The drama club reprinted the script with fewer pages.
sets.example_zh: 戏剧社重印了剧本，页数比以前少。

sets.example_en: At this harbour restaurant, fresh seafood is the special dish.
sets.example_zh: 在这家港口餐馆，新鲜海鲜是招牌菜。

sets.example_en: Our family spends every August at the seaside with friends.
sets.example_zh: 我们家每年八月都和朋友们在海滨度过。

sets.example_en: The school secretary printed the letters after lunch.
sets.example_zh: 学校秘书午饭后把那些信打印了出来。

sets.example_en: Dad works in the records section of the hospital.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸在医院的档案部门工作。

sets.example_en: Seize the chance to speak English.
sets.example_zh: 抓住说英语的机会。

sets.example_en: We select fresh apples at the market on Saturday.
sets.example_zh: 星期六我们在市场挑选新鲜的苹果。

sets.example_en: The senior students organised the sports day stalls.
sets.example_zh: 高年级学生组织了运动会的摊位。

sets.example_en: It is sensible to carry water when you hike in summer.
sets.example_zh: 夏天徒步时带上水是明智的。

sets.example_en: She is halfway through a series of mystery novels.
sets.example_zh: 那套推理小说她已经读了一半。

sets.example_en: In the story, the servant opened the gate.
sets.example_zh: 故事里仆人打开了大门。

sets.example_en: From many homes, sewage goes to a new cleaning plant in the city.
sets.example_zh: 许多家庭的污水被送到城里一座新的净化厂。

sets.example_en: The application form asks for age, name, and sex.
sets.example_zh: 申请表上要填写年龄、姓名和性别。

sets.example_en: His shadow stretched across the path.
sets.example_zh: 他的影子拉在小路上。

sets.example_en: That sharp knife belongs in the drawer, away from children.
sets.example_zh: 那把锋利的刀应该放在抽屉里，远离孩子。

sets.example_en: Write your class number at the top of the sheet.
sets.example_zh: 把你的班级号写在这张纸的上方。

sets.example_en: They waited in a bus shelter.
sets.example_zh: 他们在公交候车亭里等。

sets.example_en: In less than one hour, the shoemaker repaired both my boots.
sets.example_zh: 不到一个小时，鞋匠就把我的两只靴子修好了。

sets.example_en: With a smile, the shopkeeper gave the child a free apple.
sets.example_zh: 店主微笑着给了孩子一个免费的苹果。

sets.example_en: Waves broke on the shore.
sets.example_zh: 浪花拍在岸上。

sets.example_en: Snow on the rooftops made a lovely sight at dawn.
sets.example_zh: 黎明时分，屋顶上的雪构成一幅可爱的景象。

sets.example_en: Your signature is needed on this form before the school trip.
sets.example_zh: 学校旅行之前，这份表格上需要你的签名。

sets.example_en: Silence filled the exam room.
sets.example_zh: 考场里一片寂静。

sets.example_en: I sincerely thank you for your help.
sets.example_zh: 我真诚地感谢你的帮助。

sets.example_en: The stone will sink in water.
sets.example_zh: 石头会沉入水中。

sets.example_en: Sip the hot tea slowly so you do not burn your tongue.
sets.example_zh: 热茶要慢慢小口喝，以免烫到舌头。

sets.example_en: Workers fenced off the building site beside the gym.
sets.example_zh: 工人们把体育馆旁边的建筑工地围了起来。

sets.example_en: Every visitor stared at the dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
sets.example_zh: 每位游客都盯着博物馆里的恐龙骨骼看。

sets.example_en: Don't skip breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 不要不吃早餐。

sets.example_en: Please do not slam the door when the baby is sleeping.
sets.example_zh: 宝宝睡觉时，请不要砰地把门关上。

sets.example_en: In the legend the knight must slay the dragon to save the town.
sets.example_zh: 传说中，骑士必须杀死恶龙才能拯救小镇。

sets.example_en: Across the bright stage, the slender dancer moved very lightly.
sets.example_zh: 苗条的舞者非常轻盈地走过明亮的舞台。

sets.example_en: She ate a slice of bread.
sets.example_zh: 她吃了一片面包。

sets.example_en: The children slide down the hill.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们从山上滑下来。

sets.example_en: You might slip on the icy steps outside the dorm.
sets.example_zh: 你可能会在宿舍外结冰的台阶上滑倒。

sets.example_en: In that old story, the sly fox stole food from a farm.
sets.example_zh: 在那个古老的故事里，狡猾的狐狸从农场偷走了食物。

sets.example_en: If you kick too hard, the ball may smash the kitchen window.
sets.example_zh: 如果你踢得太用力，球可能会打碎厨房的窗户。

sets.example_en: During the team meeting, his snappy reply made everyone laugh.
sets.example_zh: 队会期间，他干脆的回答把大家都逗笑了。

sets.example_en: Cover your mouth when you sneeze.
sets.example_zh: 打喷嚏时捂住嘴。

sets.example_en: Dogs sniff the ground when they look for a lost ball.
sets.example_zh: 狗寻找丢失的球时会嗅地面。

sets.example_en: My father may snore loudly after a long day at work.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸工作了一整天后，可能会大声打鼾。

sets.example_en: When it saw the open gate, the horse began to snort.
sets.example_zh: 那匹马看见大门敞开，就开始喷鼻息。

sets.example_en: After the first snowfall, we built a snowman in the garden.
sets.example_zh: 第一场雪之后，我们在花园里堆了一个雪人。

sets.example_en: Wash your hands with soap before you sit down to eat.
sets.example_zh: 坐下吃饭之前，要用肥皂把手洗干净。

sets.example_en: Anna is sociable and talks with new students at lunch.
sets.example_zh: 安娜很好交际，午饭时会和新同学聊天。

sets.example_en: The solid table can hold a heavy stack of books.
sets.example_zh: 这张结实的桌子能放下厚厚一摞书。

sets.example_en: Let's meet sometime next week for a walk in the park.
sets.example_zh: 我们下周找个时间去公园散步吧。

sets.example_en: Which sort of sandwich do you want in your lunchbox?
sets.example_zh: 你想在午餐盒里放哪种三明治？

sets.example_en: The green apple tastes sour.
sets.example_zh: 青苹果尝起来是酸的。

sets.example_en: Southern cities stay warm even in late December.
sets.example_zh: 南方的城市即使到十二月下旬也很暖和。

sets.example_en: On a quiet red planet, the spaceship in the film finally landed.
sets.example_zh: 电影里的宇宙飞船最终降落在一颗寂静的红色星球上。

sets.example_en: Dad used a spade to plant flowers along the garden wall.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸用铲子沿着花园的墙种下了花。

sets.example_en: When the team scored, every spectator stood up and cheered.
sets.example_zh: 球队进球时，每一位观众都站起来欢呼。

sets.example_en: This spice makes the chicken taste richer and warmer.
sets.example_zh: 这种香料让鸡肉吃起来更浓郁、更温热。

sets.example_en: For my little brother, the spicy noodles were much too hot.
sets.example_zh: 这辣面条对我弟弟来说实在太辣了。

sets.example_en: A large spider sat in the web above the shed door.
sets.example_zh: 一只大蜘蛛停在棚屋门上方的网上。

sets.example_en: Children splash water at each other in the swimming pool.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们在游泳池里互相溅水。

sets.example_en: Sprinkle a little salt on the eggs before you serve them.
sets.example_zh: 上菜之前，在鸡蛋上撒一点盐。

sets.example_en: Grilled squid is my favourite dish at the night market.
sets.example_zh: 烤鱿鱼是我在夜市最喜欢的菜。

sets.example_en: The new stadium holds 50,000 people.
sets.example_zh: 新体育场能容纳五万人。

sets.example_en: Kitchen staff prepared sandwiches for the sports day.
sets.example_zh: 厨房人员为运动会准备了三明治。

sets.example_en: Hold the rail on the stair.
sets.example_zh: 在楼梯上扶好栏杆。

sets.example_en: We bought oranges from a fruit stall near the station.
sets.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的水果摊买了橙子。

sets.example_en: There is a statue of a famous poet in the square.
sets.example_zh: 广场上有一座著名诗人的雕像。

sets.example_en: Keep a steady pace so you can finish the long race.
sets.example_zh: 保持稳定的步伐，这样你就能完成这场长跑。

sets.example_en: We grilled one steak and plenty of corn outside.
sets.example_zh: 我们在外面烤了一块牛排，还有不少玉米。

sets.example_en: Along the wide river, the old steamboat carried many passengers.
sets.example_zh: 那艘旧汽船载着许多乘客，沿着宽阔的河行驶。

sets.example_en: Workers painted the steel bridge blue last month.
sets.example_zh: 工人们上个月把那座钢铁桥漆成了蓝色。

sets.example_en: I have a stomachache after lunch.
sets.example_zh: 午饭后我胃痛。

sets.example_en: My little sister asked me to read her favourite storybook before bedtime.
sets.example_zh: 我妹妹让我在睡前给她读她最喜欢的故事书。

sets.example_en: A clear stream ran through the wood.
sets.example_zh: 一条清澈的小溪穿过树林。

sets.example_en: This kite needs new string before it can fly again.
sets.example_zh: 这只风筝得换上新细线，才能再飞起来。

sets.example_en: They record the school podcast in a tiny studio.
sets.example_zh: 他们在一间很小的工作室里录制学校播客。

sets.example_en: After the rain stopped, the view from the hotel window was stunning.
sets.example_zh: 雨停之后，酒店窗外的景色美极了。

sets.example_en: Leaving my phone on the bus was a stupid mistake.
sets.example_zh: 把手机落在公交车上是个愚蠢的错误。

sets.example_en: She wore a stylish coat to the city concert last Friday.
sets.example_zh: 上周五她穿着一件时髦的外套去听了城里的音乐会。

sets.example_en: We followed the subtitle at the bottom to understand the French film.
sets.example_zh: 我们靠底部的字幕看懂了这部法国电影。

sets.example_en: Can you subtract fifteen from forty without using a calculator?
sets.example_zh: 你能不用计算器从四十里面减去十五吗？

sets.example_en: Take the subway to the museum.
sets.example_zh: 坐地铁去博物馆。

sets.example_en: After the broken oven caused a fire, the shop owner decided to sue the company.
sets.example_zh: 坏烤箱引起火灾后，店主决定起诉那家公司。

sets.example_en: My suggestion was to start the meeting earlier.
sets.example_zh: 我的提议是把会议提前开始。

sets.example_en: That was a super performance.
sets.example_zh: 那是一场极好的演出。

sets.example_en: My cousin dressed as superman for the school play and made everyone laugh.
sets.example_zh: 我表弟在学校话剧里扮成超人，把大家都逗笑了。

sets.example_zh: 游完泳以后，晚饭是热乎的鱼和米饭。

sets.example_zh: 下周三拍班级合影之前，我需要理个发。

sets.example_zh: 下课后，勤劳的学生留下来完成小组项目。

sets.example_zh: 我们的校长在校门口迎接每一位学生。

sets.example_zh: 嘿！你的书掉在地上了。

sets.example_zh: 从我们镇上到城里，新公路缩短了路程。

sets.example_zh: 许多人在春节期间回到自己的家乡。

sets.example_zh: 我的邻居是家庭主妇，每天给家人做午饭。

sets.example_zh: 长途徒步之后，饥饿让我们去找一家小餐馆。

sets.example_zh: 这条习语的意思是重新开始。

sets.example_zh: 这个故事确实是真的。

sets.example_zh: 风这么冷，妈妈一定会坚持让我们穿厚外套。

sets.example_zh: 明天来宾到达之前，老师会检查我们的教室。

sets.example_zh: 她是一家报纸的记者。

sets.example_zh: 今天放学回家的路上，买一千克苹果。

sets.example_zh: 我们生病时，好心的邻居把汤分给了我们。

sets.example_zh: 乘客们听见扬声器在车站播报下一趟火车。

sets.example_zh: 每小时都有一班渡轮把游客从岛上送到大陆。

sets.example_zh: 她喜欢数学，经常帮朋友解答难题。

sets.example_zh: 我们一起度过了愉快的晚上。

sets.example_zh: 电影午夜结束。

sets.example_zh: 我们在广场中央的纪念碑旁拍了照。

sets.example_zh: 他用锤子敲钉子。

sets.example_zh: 周末，这条街上的夜总会营业到很晚。

sets.example_zh: 哈尔滨位于中国东北，冬天很冷。

sets.example_zh: 今天，从西北吹来的风让湖水变得很冷。

sets.example_zh: 钥匙在教室里哪里都找不到。

sets.example_zh: 猫跳到厨房的桌子上，把鱼偷走了。

sets.example_zh: 教室太热了，所以我们在户外吃了午饭。

sets.example_zh: 在宠物店里，那只鹦鹉会说你好和再见。

sets.example_zh: 午饭时，一颗青豌豆从我的盘子里滚了出去。

sets.example_zh: 她的红色铅笔盒里装着钢笔、一把尺子和两块橡皮。

sets.example_zh: 脏盘子在厨房水槽旁堆成一堆。

sets.example_zh: 我的笔没墨水时，一位同学借给了我另一支。

sets.example_zh: 爷爷发来电报，说他将在星期五到达。

sets.example_zh: 夏日暴风雨中，响雷会把小孩子吓坏。

sets.example_zh: 如果午饭后还要用课本，就把它留在桌上。

sets.example_zh: 炎热加上长跑，让我渴得厉害。

sets.example_zh: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。

sets.example_zh: 这家面包店周六晚上一直开到六点。

sets.example_zh: 在跑道上跑的时候，要待在自己的赛道里。

sets.example_zh: 我们学校典型的早餐是米饭和鸡蛋。

sets.example_zh: 打电话来的人不知道是谁，所以妈妈没有接。

sets.example_zh: 这起盗窃案的受害人描述了他丢失的手机。

sets.example_zh: 在小餐馆里，一位西方人询问怎样使用筷子。

sets.example_zh: 从北京出发，火车向西驶向高山。

sets.example_zh: 我父亲在工作场所放着一张我们的全家福。

sets.example_zh: 字母 UN 代表一个组织。

sets.example_zh: 老师讲课时我做笔记。

sets.example_zh: 他直到中午才出现。

sets.example_zh: 在校门口等我。

sets.example_zh: 我在闹钟响之前醒来。

sets.example_zh: 别难过，这毕竟只是一场比赛。

sets.example_zh: 我喜欢米饭。至于面条，我能吃一点。

sets.example_zh: 像往常一样，她早到了五分钟。

sets.example_zh: 雨终于停了。

sets.example_zh: 另外，我们还需要两把椅子。

sets.example_en: There are thirty students in all.
sets.example_zh: 总共有三十名学生。

sets.example_en: You should stay in bed if you feel ill.
sets.example_zh: 如果生病，你应该卧床休息。

sets.example_en: In case of fire, use the stairs.
sets.example_zh: 如果发生火灾，走楼梯。

sets.example_en: We have a lot in common.
sets.example_zh: 我们有很多共同之处。

sets.example_en: She stayed in control of the boat.
sets.example_zh: 她控制着那条船。

sets.example_en: The old bridge is in danger.
sets.example_zh: 那座旧桥处于危险中。

sets.example_en: Please write the answer in English.
sets.example_zh: 请用英语写下答案。

sets.example_en: In fact, the shop is just around the corner.
sets.example_zh: 事实上，商店就在拐角处。

sets.example_en: A dog sat in front of the gate.
sets.example_zh: 一只狗坐在大门前面。

sets.example_en: In general, buses here are on time.
sets.example_zh: 一般来说，这里的公交准时。

sets.example_en: We collected coats for people in need.
sets.example_zh: 我们为困境中的人募集了外套。

sets.example_en: The plant is in need of water.
sets.example_zh: 这株植物需要水。

sets.example_en: She got up early in order to catch the train.
sets.example_zh: 她早起是为了赶上火车。

sets.example_en: His arm was in pain after the fall.
sets.example_zh: 摔倒后他的胳膊疼痛。

sets.example_en: You must sign the form in person.
sets.example_zh: 你必须亲自在表上签名。

sets.example_en: He does not like to sing in public.
sets.example_zh: 他不喜欢当众唱歌。

sets.example_en: She helped me, and I cooked dinner in return.
sets.example_zh: 她帮了我，我做饭作为回报。

sets.example_en: We walked home in silence.
sets.example_zh: 我们沉默地走回了家。

sets.example_en: She looked up in surprise.
sets.example_zh: 她惊讶地抬起头。

sets.example_en: In that case, we can meet tomorrow.
sets.example_zh: 既然那样，我们可以明天见。

sets.example_en: In the end, they found the lost key.
sets.example_zh: 最后他们找到了丢失的钥匙。

sets.example_en: The driver sits in the front of the bus.
sets.example_zh: 司机坐在公交车的前部。

sets.example_en: I want to be a doctor in the future.
sets.example_zh: 将来我想当医生。

sets.example_en: The table is in the middle of the room.
sets.example_zh: 桌子在房间中间。

sets.example_en: I brush my teeth in the morning.
sets.example_zh: 我早上刷牙。

sets.example_en: We got to the hall in time for the talk.
sets.example_zh: 我们及时赶到礼堂听讲座。

sets.example_en: The tickets cost sixty yuan in total.
sets.example_zh: 票价合计六十元。

sets.example_en: Ask a teacher if you are in trouble.
sets.example_zh: 如果遇到麻烦，就去问老师。

sets.example_en: Let us walk instead of taking a taxi.
sets.example_zh: 我们走路吧，而不是打车。

sets.example_en: I sit next to the window.
sets.example_zh: 我坐在窗户旁边。

sets.example_en: Of course you can borrow my ruler.
sets.example_zh: 你当然可以借我的尺子。

sets.example_en: The match stopped on account of the rain.
sets.example_zh: 比赛由于下雨停了。

sets.example_en: All the passengers are on board.
sets.example_zh: 所有乘客都已登机。

sets.example_en: Dad is in Shenzhen on business.
sets.example_zh: 爸爸在深圳出差。

sets.example_en: The photos are on display in the hall.
sets.example_zh: 照片在大厅展出。

sets.example_en: Who is on duty today?
sets.example_zh: 今天谁值班？

sets.example_en: Call for help if the kitchen is on fire.
sets.example_zh: 如果厨房着火，就呼救。

sets.example_en: It takes ten minutes on foot.
sets.example_zh: 步行要十分钟。

sets.example_en: We have enough water on hand.
sets.example_zh: 我们手头有足够的水。

sets.example_en: She finished the model on her own.
sets.example_zh: 她靠自己完成了模型。

sets.example_en: These shirts are on sale today.
sets.example_zh: 这些衬衫今天减价出售。

sets.example_en: New paintings are on show this week.
sets.example_zh: 新画这周公开展览。

sets.example_en: I looked up the word on the Internet.
sets.example_zh: 我在网上查了这个词。

sets.example_en: The bank is on the left.
sets.example_zh: 银行在左边。

sets.example_en: Mum is on the phone with Aunt Li.
sets.example_zh: 妈妈在和李阿姨打电话。

sets.example_en: We heard the news on the radio.
sets.example_zh: 我们从收音机里听到了新闻。

sets.example_en: There is a map on the wall.
sets.example_zh: 墙上有一张地图。

sets.example_en: I bought bread on the way home.
sets.example_zh: 我在回家的路上买了面包。

sets.example_en: The train left on time.
sets.example_zh: 火车准时离开了。

sets.example_en: We watched the game on TV.
sets.example_zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

sets.example_en: They are on vacation in Qingdao.
sets.example_zh: 他们在青岛度假。

sets.example_en: The child asked the same question over and over again.
sets.example_zh: 孩子一遍又一遍地问同一个问题。

sets.example_en: Thanks to your map, we did not get lost.
sets.example_zh: 多亏你的地图，我们没有迷路。

sets.example_en: To be honest, I prefer the old song.
sets.example_zh: 说实话，我更喜欢那首老歌。

sets.example_en: To my surprise, the test was easy.
sets.example_zh: 令我吃惊的是，测验很简单。

sets.example_en: Without doubt, she is our best runner.
sets.example_zh: 毫无疑问，她是我们最好的赛跑选手。

sets.example_en: I feel a bit tired after the game.
sets.example_zh: 比赛后我有点儿累。

sets.example_en: Add a bit of salt to the soup.
sets.example_zh: 汤里加一点点盐。

sets.example_en: I will stay for a couple of days.
sets.example_zh: 我会待上几天。

sets.example_en: A few students are still in the classroom.
sets.example_zh: 一些学生还在教室里。

sets.example_en: A good many birds rest by the lake.
sets.example_zh: 许多鸟在湖边休息。

sets.example_en: A panda is a kind of animal.
sets.example_zh: 熊猫是一种动物。

sets.example_en: There is a little milk in the glass.
sets.example_zh: 杯子里有一点牛奶。

sets.example_en: We saw a lot of stars last night.
sets.example_zh: 昨晚我们看见许多星星。

sets.example_en: A number of parents came to the show.
sets.example_zh: 若干位家长来看了演出。

sets.example_en: I need a pair of sports shoes.
sets.example_zh: 我需要一双运动鞋。

sets.example_en: Please give me a piece of paper.
sets.example_zh: 请给我一张纸。

sets.example_en: The class starts at a quarter past eight.
sets.example_zh: 课在八点一刻开始。

sets.example_en: All in all, it was a happy day.
sets.example_zh: 总的来说，这是愉快的一天。

sets.example_en: The market sells all kinds of fruit.
sets.example_zh: 市场卖各种各样的水果。

sets.example_en: All of a sudden, the lights went out.
sets.example_zh: 突然，灯灭了。

sets.example_en: There is paint all over his shirt.
sets.example_zh: 他衬衫上到处都是颜料。

sets.example_en: People all over the world like football.
sets.example_zh: 全世界的人都喜欢足球。

sets.example_en: If you feel all right, we can start.
sets.example_zh: 如果你觉得没事，我们可以开始。

sets.example_en: All the best for your new school.
sets.example_zh: 祝你在新学校万事如意。

sets.example_en: The baby cried all the time on the bus.
sets.example_zh: 宝宝在公交车上一直哭。

sets.example_en: We bought pens, paper, and so on.
sets.example_zh: 我们买了笔、纸等等。

sets.example_en: Hundreds of people waited outside.
sets.example_zh: 数以百计的人在外面等。

sets.example_en: The two bags are more or less the same.
sets.example_zh: 两个包差不多一样。

sets.example_en: There is plenty of time before the film.
sets.example_zh: 电影开始前还有大量时间。

sets.example_en: Thousands of lights shine on the bridge.
sets.example_zh: 桥上有成千上万盏灯。
